verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of a background automation is a developer-site use case: when a PDF lands in an inbox folder, Box AI Extract automatically pulls fields into metadata. That is an event-triggered workflow, but it is a single thin mention. Webhooks and event streams are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder, recurring schedules, autonomous agent execution in the background, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: When a PDF lands in your inbox folder, Box AI Extract pulls vendor, dates, and totals into searchable metadata.
